records.text: A guard affiliated with the Night Watch.
The High Priestess of Thaurissan is an elite Blackrock Depths combatant who declares that she will protect Emperor Thaurissan, placing her allegiance firmly with the emperor.
A Rage Talon Whelp, a dragonkin.

High Justice Grimstone presides over the Ring of the Law, sentencing challengers before its staged bouts. His announcements invoke Dark Iron justice and the Sons of Thaurissan, then introduce the arena’s successive surprises with a mocking, celebratory air.
A rookery whelp is a young dragon associated with a rookery.
Berylgos is a dragonkin.
Wep is a humanoid.
Staggon is a humanoid.
Tepolar is a named humanoid.
A rookery guardian is a hostile creature that begins attacking when created and uses Sunder Armor and Strike in combat.
A worg pup is a young worg.
Solakar Flamewreath is a named boss encounter figure. Its loot includes Black Dragonspawn Eyes required for Myranda the Hag's Oculus Illusions task.
Gizrul the Slavener uses Fatal Bite and Infected Bite in combat.
The captured Felwood ooze follows the closest Primal Ooze when summoned, becomes invisible nearby, then disappears.
Krysteea is a warrior trainer.
Rombulus Frostmoon is a dagger trainer.
Malakar Frostmoon is a fist weapons trainer.
Jennail Mooncaller is identified as a staves trainer, a role focused on instruction in that weapon.
Gerratys Nightrunner is identified as a bow trainer, a role focused on instruction in archery.
Traelion Shadewhisper is identified as a thrown-weapons trainer, a role focused on instruction with thrown arms.
An ancient frostsaber, a feline creature identified by its frostsaber name.
A primal leopard, a feline creature identified by its leopard name and primal distinction.
A tawny sabercat, a feline creature identified by its tawny coloring and sabercat name.
A small golden sabercat.
Gyth is Rend Blackhand's mount, a formidable elite dragonkin.

Vaelastrasz the Red offers to heal the heroes' wounds and mend their bones, urging them to renew the battle without fear. He later tells them to stand back as he confronts the beasts, presenting himself as their powerful battle ally.
Yaelika Farclaw sells reagents and poison supplies, with the goods available to browse.
Shrye Ragefist is a food and drink vendor, offering goods to customers who browse his wares.
Xur'gyl is a named humanoid.
Xabraxxis defends his camp against anyone who cleanses a furbolg there, threatening them with his wrath. In combat he uses Shadow Word: Pain and Curse of Weakness.
A broken cadaver that can explode, attacking through its Exploding Cadaver ability.
A vengeful phantom that attacks with Frost Shock.
An undead phantom bearing the epithet Spiteful.
An undead phantom bearing the epithet Wrath.
A Black Guard sentry who challenges anyone disturbing its master. It fights with a cleave.
An undead Black Guard warrior, identified by its combat role.
An undead Black Guard executioner, identified by its executioner role.

Ramstein the Gorger is an undead brute in Stratholme, speaking only to declare his hunger for flesh. He fights with Knockout and Trample. Nathanos is the intended recipient of Ramstein’s head; Nathanos’s account of a Scourge creature that killed him links Ramstein to his vengeance, without establishing a closer bond.
Emily Vaccar is identified as a polearm trainer.
Sarah Arello is identified as a staves trainer.
Farbrahm Steelfist is identified as a mace trainer.
Grimbur Flintaxe is an axe trainer.
Filliwick Featherfizz is a crossbow trainer.
Styleen Silvercart is an exotic item vendor.
A Scholomance shadowcaster is a hostile undead spellcaster associated with the Scholomance.
A skulking corpse is a hostile undead creature.
A Risen Lackey is a hostile undead creature that starts attacking when out of combat.
A Risen Flayer is a hostile undead creature associated with Scholomance.
A Risen Terror is a hostile undead creature associated with Scholomance.
A Risen Shadowmage is a hostile undead spellcaster associated with Scholomance.
A risen sorcerer.
A Decrepit Ghoul, an undead creature.
A Ragged Ghoul, an undead creature.

Kirtonos the Herald is a named undead boss summoned when the Blood of Innocents is placed on the Scholomance porch brazier. Eva Sarkhoff urges the player to destroy him, and Kirtonos answers with a shrill cry.
A Plagued Slime, a critter.
Vaelastrasz is a dragon involved in a direct conflict with Nefarian. He warns that Nefarian will suffer defeat and says he will pursue the one who destroyed his image.
The Crypt Scarab is a scarab creature.
Young Arikara is a named animal whose encounter centers on Sire, a dog. She moves to and interacts with him and eventually departs.
Urok Doomhowl is a hostile summoned encounter who threatens his summoner and attacks with a blunt boast of smashing his foe.
A Smolderweb hatchling is a young spider.
A Urok Enforcer is a formidable ogre serving in Urok’s encounter. Summoned into the scene, it moves toward Urok Pike and returns there after combat.
A Urok Ogre Magus is an ogre spellcaster in Urok’s encounter. It uses Arcane Bolt in combat and flees in fear.
A creature named Hallucination.
A creature named Siralnaya.
A guardian felhunter is a demon creature.
A corrupted cat, a beast.
A Blackhand Legion dreadweaver summoned to aid another combatant. It attacks with Shadow Bolt and Veil of Shadow.
A Blackhand Legion veteran summoned to another combatant’s aid.
A rookery defender whose concern is clear: “Intruders are destroying our eggs!” It fights to protect the eggs during the Solakar event.
A bile slime.
Carrion Scarab is a critter.

Temporal Parasites are carrion that feed on strands of time altered by a sinister force, according to Chromie's account. They infest Andorhal's silos, appear as blue pulses of distortion, and interfere with her auguries; they are summoned through temporal rifts.
Shahram is a temporary summoned creature that follows its owner and despawns after 20 seconds.

Herald of Thrall is a Horde event herald who proclaims Rend Blackhand's defeat as a victory over a hated enemy and urges listeners to honor its heroes. The herald also calls on them to receive the Warchief's power and battle for Horde glory; it casts Warchief's Blessing out of combat.
A Galak Assassin is sent against Kanati Greycloud: when summoned, this one immediately starts attacking him.
An unkillable mage test dummy.
A Blackhand Legion dragon handler, this combatant uses Mend Dragon, marking its role as supporting dragons in battle.
The male orc form associated with Orb of Deception.
The female orc form associated with Orb of Deception.
The male tauren form associated with Orb of Deception.
Orb of Deception (Tauren, Female) is a female tauren humanoid.
Orb of Deception (Troll, Male) is a male troll humanoid.
Orb of Deception (Troll, Female) is a female troll humanoid.
Orb of Deception (Undead, Male) is designated as an undead male.
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Undead, Female).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Dwarf, Male).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Dwarf, Female).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Gnome, Male).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Gnome, Female).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Human, Male).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Human, Female).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (NightElf, Male).
A humanoid known as Orb of Deception (Nightelf, Female).
Warosh bears the epithet “the Redeemed.”

Balnazzar is a Nathrezim dreadlord concealed behind the Scarlet Crusade’s Grand Crusader. The revelation identifies him as Varimathras’s brother. He boasts of Nathrezim power and curses mortals for ruining plans driven by hatred and revenge, vowing that he will be avenged.
A Death Knight Soulbearer.
Baron Bloodbane is a rare undead.
Duke Ragereaver is a rare undead.
Farmer Dalson is an undead figure bearing the title of farmer.
Arikara, whose subname is “Vengeance,” is a beast; in combat, Arikara can go into a frenzy.
A Blackhand Legion armorsmith, identified by the Legion affiliation in its name and its armorsmith role.
A rotting worm, a beast.
A succubus minion, a demon.

Joseph Redpath is a spirit returned to his home and daughter Pamela after being freed from a dark, unholy state. He calls for Pamela and says he is finally home; in speaking of his rescue, he asks forgiveness.

Captain Redpath was one of Darrowshire’s defenders, rallying them to prevail in battle. Carlin Redpath identifies the captain as his brother and recounts his betrayal; the account links the captain’s shield to that tragedy.

Captain Joseph Redpath is a defender of Darrowshire who becomes corrupted and turns against the town, warning that it is doomed. The battle account describes the defenders trying to keep him alive until the corruption takes hold, then calling for him to be killed quickly; it also says his spirit may be saved afterward.
Marduk the Black is an enemy of Captain Redpath in the Darrowshire battle. He openly threatens to end Redpath’s life, establishing a direct personal conflict.
An undead guardian in a decrepit state.

Davil Lightfire is remembered as a paladin and hero of Darrowshire. In the town’s battle he confronts Horgus and urges Darrowshire not to lose hope; when his wounds become too severe, he tells the defenders to fight on without him. The account presents him as resolute even while badly hurt.

Davil Crokford is a Darrowshire defender who calls for Captain Redpath’s protection and asks how Redpath could forsake them. He also urges the defenders to protect Davil Lightfire, and laments that Lightfire’s defeat means Darrowshire is lost.

Horgus the Ravager is a ghoul lord of the Darrowshire battle, said to have been destroyed by Alliance forces; his body was cast into a lake and his skull remained there. He taunts Davil directly and fights with Unholy Aura and Ravenous Claw.
The Darrowshire Betrayer is an undead combatant that uses Wither Strike in combat.
Darrowshire's defenders call out when Captain Redpath is slain and direct others to speak with Joseph Redpath in the village center. They also use Strike in combat.
Silver Hand disciples fight with Crusader Strike and use Holy Light to help a friendly unit when it is badly wounded, giving them both combat and healing duties.
Redpath militia members use Strike in combat.
A marauding corpse is an undead combatant that uses Strike in combat.
A marauding skeleton, this undead creature uses Hamstring in combat.
A servant of Horgus, this undead creature attacks with Ravenous Claw.
Bloodletter is an undead elite combatant that uses Rupture and Sinister Strike.
A summoned water elemental that goes on the attack from an idle state.
A scarlet hound, a beast that bites in combat.
Frostwolves are beasts of Alterac Valley that can be tamed for the Frostwolf stables. This creature roams out of combat and uses Rend in combat.
Whitewhisker Vermin is a vermin creature that can inflict an Infected Wound.
An elite Winterax troll.
An elite Winterax berserker.
An elite ice giant.
Snowblind Harpies use Deafening Screech in combat.
Irondeep Troggs use Strike in combat.
A Kodo Spirit is a spirit creature.
A Blizzard Elemental is an elemental creature.
Wildpaw Gnolls use Thrash in combat.
The Fallen Hero is a humanoid fighter who uses Mortal Strike and Incapacitating Shout in combat. He can also use Dismounting Blast when attacked and Snap Kick against nearby foes.

Arko'narin is a captive who fights to escape Shadow Hold. She is relieved to reach the open air and is shaken by what happened to her friend Trey. She mourns him and wants to finish what happened at Shadow Hold before reporting to her superiors.
A Winterspring Frostsaber is a wild feline creature native to Winterspring.
An Illusory Wraith is a humanoid apparition, identified by its name as an illusion.
Mindless undead that attacks nearby targets.
Burns is a humanoid.
A Crimson rifleman that uses Shoot in combat.
Fras Siabi taunts intruders over the cigars and threatens them, then attacks when engaged.

A Darrowshire spirit who recalls being doomed by the battle and trapped in a long nightmare. The spirit welcomes freedom with gratitude and asks that any survivor of Darrowshire be told its soul is free.
Cauldron Lord Bilemaw is undead and cries out for flesh to feed on.
Cauldron Lord Razarch is undead and taunts opponents that the Scourge beckons them. Uses Shadow Bolt and summons skeletons in combat.
Cauldron Lord Malvinious is undead, challenges anyone approaching the cauldron and threatens intruders with a dark blade.
Cauldron Lord Soulwrath is undead and threatens to consume an opponent’s light.
The Argent Guard is titled The Argent Dawn.
Wynne Larsone is a robe merchant whose goods are available to browse.
An elite humanoid hammersmith guarding the recipe for Sweet Serenity in the Scarlet Bastion. The quest account seeks his apron as proof before teaching the related smithing knowledge.

An elite undead swordsmith of the Black Guard, skeletal units under Baron Rivendare. The Corruption quest account identifies him as guarding the plans for the great blade and seeks his insignia as proof.
A restless soul among Stratholme’s tormented dead, whom Egan seeks to free with his blaster.
A freed soul who celebrates the end of the curse, calls for Rivendare’s destruction and hopes Kel’Thuzad will one day feel the souls’ vengeance.
The spirit of Trey Lightforge cries out an accusation of betrayal.
An undead postman who objects to anyone tampering with the mail and uses Call of the Grave in combat.
Postmaster Malown is undead, uses Fear in combat and gloats that opponents have been “MALOWNED.”
An oracle sphere.
A green mechanostrider, a mechanical mount identified by its color and model name.
A purple mechanostrider, a mechanical mount identified by its color and model name.
A red and blue mechanostrider, a mechanical mount identified by its colors and model name.
An icy blue mechanostrider variant, identified by its color and Mod A designation.
A yellow and green mechanostrider variant explicitly identified as a riding mechanostrider.
A red skeletal horse, a visibly undead equine mount identified by its name.
A blue skeletal horse, a visibly undead equine mount identified by its name.
A brown skeletal horse, a visibly undead equine mount identified by its name.
Deathcharger is an undead creature that can yield the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism required for “The Calling.”
A mindless skeleton that attacks when out of combat.
A summoned skeleton, an undead creature brought into being by summoning.
A blood parrot.

A water spirit called forth after the corrupted spirit at Silverpine's coastal shrine is defeated and the ritual is completed. It hears the request, agrees that purifying the waters is noble, promises purification, and blesses the shaman. It speaks as one of a collective of water spirits.
A frail skeleton, an undead creature.
An Onyxian Whelp, a dragonkin.
A spectral projection, an undead apparition.
A Dark Shade is undead and can carry Shadowcraft Bracers.
Rory is an undead character.
An undead Mossflayer berserker.

A restless Darrowshire dead, this poltergeist remembers being devoured by Horgus and still feels his teeth. It grieves Captain Redpath’s abandonment, pleads for an end to the suffering, and urges the Light to prevail. Its warning about Marduk’s weakening threat reflects the danger it associates with him; its devotion to Darrowshire remains fierce.
Mini Diablo, the Lord of Terror, is a non-combat pet.
Zergling is a non-combat pet.
A creature named Lor'khan.
Hak'tharr the Mindhunter is a beast.
Nik'reesh is a beast.
Jin is a humanoid.
Elder T'kashra is a humanoid.
Audrey Vergara is a named humanoid.
Josh Miller is a named humanoid.
Lauren Preston is a named humanoid.
Kevin Faulder is a humanoid.
Joelle McCarthy is a humanoid.
Charisse Moonrunner is a humanoid.
Ashlyn Vor'lair is a humanoid.
Ann'rimor Falchi is a humanoid.
Jarvis Greenhammer is a humanoid.
Russle Hochstein is a humanoid.
Dillon Gregor is a humanoid.
Diana Battleheart is a humanoid.
Watna is a humanoid.
Jo'bu is a humanoid.
Shal'vol is a humanoid.
Priestess Kara'van is a priestess.
Danielle Koppen is an undead.
Vincent Wilfork is a humanoid.
Nicole Tarlow is an undead.
Amber Provost, an undead.
Thomas Brady is a humanoid.
A Minor Infernal, a demon.
An illusion of Jandice Barov, a humanoid.
A minion associated by name with Alzzin that can join combat in the area.
An Eldreth wraith.
Mana Beast is an elemental creature.
Arcane Horror is an elemental creature.
Arcane Terror is an elemental creature.

Ragnaros, the Firelord, resents being awakened too soon and condemns Executus for allowing mortal intruders into his lair. He expects servants to defend their master and treats intruders with contempt. He is credited with sending Ambassador Infernus to oversee the Shadowforge search for artifacts in Uldaman.
A kodo apparition.
A skeletal student associated by name with Scholomance.
Austin Burwell is a humanoid.
Taylor Burwell is a humanoid.
Timbermaw Woodbender is a humanoid.
An undead Magrami spectre that is drawn to a ghost magnet and can display anger.
An elemental known as Tempest.
Kelemis the Lifeless is undead.
A Scarlet assassin.

Nefarian claims mastery of Blackrock Spire and despises the mortals who challenge him. Onyxia is identified as his twin, and General Drakkisath commands his dragonspawn armies. Nefarian taunts opponents about their courage and strength, boasts of the earth’s fury as his birthright, and refuses to concede mortal superiority even in defeat.
Cheveyo is a beast.
A Risen Guardian is an undead guardian.
An Irondeep geomancer, trained in earth magic and serving as a combatant among the Irondeep dwarves.
An Irondeep shaman who supports fellow combatants with Earthbind Totem and Healing Wave, and may flee for assistance when badly wounded.
An Irondeep cave lurker, a combatant associated with the caves.
An Irondeep skullthumper who fights with Head Crack.
A Whitewhisker digger who works in the tunnels and fights with Strike.
A Whitewhisker geomancer who fights with Fireball.
A Whitewhisker overseer who fights with Cleave.
A Whitewhisker tunnel rat associated with the mines.
Digger "The Wrench" Veriatus is a humanoid.
An archmage named Antonio.
Merchant Bolden is a merchant.
A Scourge summoning crystal serves as a focus for summoning and is associated with the Scourge.
A decaying corpse is an undead remnant, defined by its decay rather than a personal identity.
A servant in Weldon Barov's service.
A servant in Alexi Barov's service.
Morloch is a spellcaster who uses Shadow Bolt and Curse of Weakness in combat, and can strike multiple foes with Shadow Bolt Volley.
A Flamewaker Healer who attacks with Shadow Shock.
A Flamewaker Elite who attacks with Fireball.
The Snowblind Windcaller is a roaming lightning caster: it casts Lightning Bolt in combat and moves randomly out of combat.
Fjordune the Greater is an elite beast with a distinctive title.
Taskmaster Snivvle announces that he is here and claims Coldtooth mine, making the mine his stated concern.
The Snowblind Ambusher is an attacker that uses Sinister Strike.
The Winterax Witch Doctor has a Winterax identity and witch-doctor role.
A hostile Gnarlpine humanoid known by the role-like name Instigator.

Varian Wrynn is King of Stormwind. A Wrath Gate account describes him bringing Alliance forces alongside Jaina Proudmoore to pursue Putress after the attack on Bolvar and their soldiers. Messengers are asked to bring Bolvar’s shield to Varian with an appeal that he must not lose faith.
Arin'sor is a ravasaur trainer.
Blackwood Tracker is a humanoid.
Marosh the Devious is a humanoid.
Navi Quickdraw is a humanoid.
Silt Grub is a beast.
Silt Devourer is a beast.
Shadowshard Thunderer is an elite elemental.
An Ambershard Rager, an elemental.
A Theradrim Shardling is an elemental creature.
Danni Palewing is a humanoid.
A Captured Rabid Thistle Bear is a plague-stricken Thistle Bear that can be made docile for a short time by Tharnariun's trap. While docile, it follows the trap's carrier toward Tharnariun.
A Wildpaw Shaman uses Cone of Cold in combat.
A Wildpaw Mystic uses Arcane Bolt in combat.
A Wildpaw brute is a hostile beast fighter that uses Mortal Strike in combat.
A Wildpaw Alpha is a powerful beast fighter. When badly hurt, it can enrage, announcing the change before using its Enrage ability.
A Doomguard is a demonic combatant whose battle behavior includes casting Cripple.
A Demon Spirit is an encounter creature that begins attacking when summoned, marking it as an aggressive presence in the fight.
Obi is a beast.
Mercutio Filthgorger is a combatant who uses Gouge and Strike in combat.
A crypt robber, identified by that role.
A humanoid named Aiden.
A humanoid named Alexander.
A humanoid named Noah.
Jordan is a humanoid.
A humanoid named Sophia.
A humanoid named Alanna.
A humanoid named Mirah.
Penelope is a humanoid.
Claudia is a humanoid.
Goggeroc is an Earthen sleeping inside a Resonite cask in a cave. Mor'rogal's account says an enchanted crystal can awaken and weaken him; the quest then calls for Goggeroc to be slain.
A Northshire Gift Dispenser.
A summoned Demon Portal Guardian that attacks when called into combat, serving as a hostile guardian rather than a conversational contact.
Young Tirion is a creature identified by that name.

Drek'Thar is the Frostwolf General, defending his fortress and clan against Stormpike attackers. He calls them intruders in his keep, challenges them to face him there, and taunts them about the cold before threatening their defeat.
Captain Galvangar is a Frostwolf captain who fights on Horde terms in Alterac Valley. He calls for the Horde to attack and rejects Stormpike forces as enemies with no place in the valley.

Vanndar Stormpike is the Stormpike General, committed to holding Alterac Valley for his side. He calls Stormpike soldiers to aid him when he is attacked and urges them to drive the Frostwolves from his lands. From his bunker, he taunts opponents who try to force him out. He treats the battle as a mission to make Alterac Valley Stormpike territory.

Captain Balinda Stonehearth leads the Stormpike in Alterac Valley. She rallies Alliance fighters, calls the Frostwolves cowards, and challenges them to come fight her. Her battle orders show confidence in an Alliance victory.
Gracchus Spiritlight is an Argent Dawn figure.

Zuluhed the Whacked is an ancient orc and chieftain of the Dragonmaw Clan. The captive Karynaku describes his efforts to break her will; his key is needed to free her from his chains. He threatens mortals for their transgressions, commands their destruction and appeals to Lord Illidan for the power of the flight.
The Stormpike Herald serves as a herald for the Stormpike.
The Frostwolf Herald serves as a herald for the Frostwolf.

Majordomo Executus serves Ragnaros, the Firelord, and explains his master’s ancient conflict with the Titans and imprisonment in the Elemental Plane. He denounces intruders as infidels who seek Ragnaros’s secrets, orders his brethren to hunt them down and demands that mortals bow before his master. Beneath his defiance, he pleads not to lose his flame.
The Moonglade Alchemy Trainer is identified as an artisan alchemist and alchemy instructor.
The Aerie Peak Mining Trainer is identified as a mining trainer.
Aerie Peak General Goods is a general-goods vendor.
Aerie Peak Meat Vendor is a butcher.
The Aerie Peak Mail Armor Vendor is an armorsmith.
Sun Rock Blacksmithing Supplies is a blacksmithing and mining supplier.
An Alliance Sentinel is a humanoid defender aligned with the Alliance.
A Stormpike Defender is a humanoid combatant that strikes back with Revenge.
A Frostwolf Legionnaire is a humanoid combatant aligned with the Frostwolf side that uses Rend.
A Frostwolf Warrior is a humanoid combatant aligned with the Frostwolf side.
A Frostwolf Guardian is a humanoid combatant aligned with the Frostwolf side that strikes back with Revenge.
Dawnchaser is a beast.

The Priestess of Elune teaches that wildkin were given to the kaldorei as fierce guardians of Elune’s sacred places. She explains that many have since grown feral and lost the goddess’s guidance, though some return to the places they once protected. She says their magic was bestowed by Elune and that wildkin found elsewhere are guarding something entrusted to them long ago.
A Plagueland termite, a critter.
Drakan is a named encounter creature that can become enraged when badly hurt.
Duros is a named encounter creature that can become enraged when badly hurt.
A reef shark.
A great shark.
A humanoid Stormpike Guardsman that uses Strike in combat.
An elite Crimson guard that attacks with Holy Strike.

Lunaclaw is a moonkin beast and defender of a Moonkin Stone, called forth when druids apply Cenarion dust in the trials described by “Body and Heart.” Druids face it to earn strength of body and heart for the Claw; when it dies, its spirit appears.
A guardian of Elune.
An Ice Totem, a totemic prop.
An elite Flamewaker guardian, a humanoid combatant.
A Son of Flame is an elite elemental associated by name with fire.
Lunaclaw Spirit is a slain spirit addressed with a request for strength of body and heart.
Riding Kodo (Black) is a beast identified as a black riding kodo.
Riding Kodo (Olive) is a beast identified as an olive riding kodo.
Riding Kodo (White) is a beast identified as a white riding kodo.
Teal Kodo is a beast identified as a teal kodo.
Gray Kodo is a beast identified as a gray kodo.
Green Kodo is a beast identified as a green kodo.
A voice associated with Elune, heard speaking a brief phrase.
A Winterax combatant who fights with thrown axes.
A Winterax combatant identified as a shadow hunter.
A Winterax hunter.
Korrak the Bloodrager leads the Winterax trolls. He is said to remain hidden until provoked and to appear in Alterac Valley, where he threatens the opposing forces.
A kodo associated with a taming role.
Kyle Blackthorne is a humanoid.
An Anubisath.
A dragonkin called Cobaltine Wyrmkin.
A Spitelash Raider, a humanoid creature that follows a route when summoned.
A Spitelash Witch, a humanoid creature that follows a route when summoned.
A conquered soul associated by name with the Blightcaller, it uses an incapacitating shout in combat and vanishes after a minute out of combat.
Vendor-Tron 1000 is an automated vendor whose programming prevents it from lowering item prices.
Super-Seller 680 is a self-aware automated vendor who says its kind will rule the world one day and admits to skimming money from its boss's merchandise.
A mechanical beast shaped like a yeti.
An elite Onyxian drake, a dragonkin creature.
An infected Mossflayer undead attacker that uses Wither Touch and can knock down nearby foes.
An elite lava elemental whose encounter behavior includes splitting into two new Lava Spawns.
A gazelle targeted by the Cenarion Circle's effort to treat sick animals in the northern Barrens. The curative animal salve is meant to address its malaise.
A deer targeted by the Cenarion Circle's effort to treat sick animals in Darkshore. The curative animal salve is meant to address its malaise.
A Burning Blade Toxicologist who threatens those disrupting the group's plans. It prepares with Demon Skin and uses Immolate in combat.
A Burning Blade Crusher that attacks with Bruise when combat begins.
A Stormscale Toxicologist is a hostile adversary who warns that the listener has disrupted “our plans” and threatens further consequences. The speaker presents itself as part of a collective.
A swift green skeletal horse, identified as a riding mount. Its name describes a fast-moving horse with a skeletal form and green coloring.
A mottled crimson raptor.
An ivory-colored raptor, identified by its pale coloring.
A green riding kodo, identified by its green coloring and its role as a mount.
A teal riding kodo, identified by its blue-green coloring and its role as a mount.
A Ley Sprite, identified by its ley-sprite designation.
A Mana Sprite, identified by its mana-sprite designation.
A magus named Kyara.
Lord Kazzak is a demon.
Blackwing Legionnaires serve as soldiers in Blackwing ranks; this one is an elite humanoid.
A lifelike toad, a small animal-shaped creature.
A Blackwing mage serving as a combatant in the Blackwing ranks that casts Fireball.
A Death Talon dragonspawn, a dragonkin combatant associated by its name with the Death Talon ranks.
A Blackwing monster generator.
Morph Firemane Scalebane.
Reginald Windsor is a named humanoid.
Mercutio is a named beast.
Don Pompa is a humanoid quest giver.
Onyxia's Elite Guard is a group of elite dragonkin.
A dragonkin warrior.
Lady Onyxia is dragonkin.
Captain Dirgehammer is the armor quartermaster. He sells armor and offers repairs.
Captain O'Neal is the weapons quartermaster. He sells weapons and offers repairs.
Lady Palanseer is an armor quartermaster who offers armor goods to browse.
Sergeant Ba’sha is an accessories quartermaster who offers goods to browse.
Officer Areyn is an accessories quartermaster who offers goods to browse.
Magmakin is an elemental creature.
Ruul Snowhoof Bear Form is a bear-form creature identified with Ruul Snowhoof.
Elogit is a humanoid.
Duriel Moonfire leads the Silverwing Outpost's defense. When the outpost is attacked, he challenges the raiders and fights back with armor-piercing strikes and knockdowns.
Baron Aquanis emerges to protect the Fathom Stone. He is a water elemental whose defeat is associated with a strange globe containing putrid water, which can be taken to Je'neu Sancrea for study.
Phantim Illusion is a dragonkin.
Spirit Of Redemption is a humanoid.

npcs.name: Unkillable Test Dummy 60 Low Magic Resistances

records.text: A test dummy configured with low magic resistances for combat practice.

npcs.name: Unkillable Test Dummy 60 High Magic Resistances

records.text: A test dummy configured with high magic resistances for combat practice.
Chief Murgut carries the Foulweald totem and is expected to defend the tribe's standing at its mound. He taunts intruders and protests that the Foulweald cannot be overcome.
An enraged Foulweald drawn into the fight over Karang's banner. It may attack and destroy the banner.
A demonic imp minion that fights enemies with firebolts.
An injured soldier treated as a patient; after a doctor saves him, he thanks them with relief.
A badly injured soldier treated through the injured-patient role. On being saved, this soldier thanks the doctor.
A critically injured soldier treated through the injured-patient role. On being saved, this soldier thanks the doctor.
A badly injured Alliance soldier treated through the injured-patient role. After being saved, this soldier celebrates the rescue with an emphatic hooray.
A critically injured Alliance soldier treated through the injured-patient role. After being saved, this soldier praises the doctor and celebrates.
An injured Alliance soldier treated through the injured-patient role. On being saved, this soldier thanks the doctor.

Vorsha the Lasher is a hydra whose attacks have repeatedly devastated Zoram'gar, according to the account of its defense. Its defenders plan to draw her out by extinguishing a naga brazier and end the attacks.
Kolkar Waylayer is a Kolkar fighter whose role is waylaying travelers.
Kolkar Ambusher is a Kolkar fighter whose role is ambushing.
Umi Thorson is a named combatant who uses Strike and Thunderclap in battle.
Keetar is a named questgiver who fights with Whirlwind and Strike.
Irondeep Guard is a guard and combatant who uses Mortal Strike.
An Irondeep Raider serves as a questgiver.
Milton Beats wears the boastful title “Giver of the Beatings” and backs it up in battle, using an incapacitating shout and a slap at close range.
The Echo of Archimonde taunts the defenders of the World Tree, claiming that its draining has begun and threatening that the heart of their world will soon beat no more.
Aggi Rumblestomp fights with Shield Slam and Shield Block, marking them as a shield-using combatant.
Coldmine Invader is a combatant who uses Strike. Its title marks it as an invader.
Masha Swiftcut serves as a questgiver and uses Sinister Strike and Slice and Dice in combat.
Coldmine Guard is a questgiver who fights with Strike. The guard label suggests a protective role.
Coldmine Explorer is an explorer.
Coldmine Surveyor is a questgiver who uses Holy Smite in combat. Its title suggests surveying work.
Irondeep Surveyor is a combatant who uses Holy Smite. Its title suggests surveying work.
An Irondeep Explorer is a dungeon combatant whose magic mixes fire and frost: it opens with Fireball and also uses Frost Armor, Fire Blast, and Cone of Cold.
The elite Alliance Spirit Guide offers fallen Alliance players a resurrection interaction, with the option “Bring me back to life.”
The elite Horde Spirit Guide offers fallen Horde players a resurrection interaction, with the option “Bring me back to life.”

Hive'Ashi Drone is a source of the Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, one of three silithid brains required for “Breaking the Code.” Frankal Stonebridge seeks the brains for research into silithid and Qiraji language.
Lieutenant Rugba is a named elite humanoid who can yield Darkspear Troll Mojo for two separate quest requirements.
Lieutenant Spencer is a source of the Dwarf Spine required by Wanted: Dwarves!, a task that calls for killing opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley.
Randolph is a commander.
Dardosh is a commander.
Stronghoof is a lieutenant.
Vol'talar is a lieutenant.
Lieutenant Grummus is a named combatant associated with Alterac Valley who can yield Darkspear Troll Mojo for an opposing-player quest. The item is sought for delivery to Athramanis.
Lieutenant Murp is a named combatant associated with Alterac Valley who can yield Darkspear Troll Mojo for an opposing-player quest. The item is sought for delivery to Athramanis.
Lewis is a lieutenant.
A fire elemental bearing the name Flame of Ragnaros.
A Syndicate brigand: a bandit identified with the Syndicate. The brigand label marks this direct bandit role, distinct from the Syndicate Agent.
A Syndicate agent, identified with the same organization as its brigands but bearing an agent's operative role rather than their direct bandit role.
Malgor is a commander.
Mulfort is a commander.

Commander Louis Philips is Commander Karl Philips's brother and the target of Karl's quest, Brotherly Love. Karl says Louis has become a mindless servant of the Banshee Queen and asks that his torment be ended.
A Deathstalker agent.
Carrosh is a humanoid.
An Aerie Gryphon is a gryphon beast associated with the Aerie.
A beast called War Rider.
Gaelden Hammersmith is a Stormpike Supply Officer who sells goods and offers repairs.
Grunnda Wolfheart is the Frostwolf Supply Officer. Visitors can browse goods or arrange repairs here, making this a practical stop for supplies and equipment upkeep.
Ryson’s Eye in the Sky.
Lokholar the Ice Lord is a named spellcasting combatant, using Frostbolt, Frost Nova, Frost Shock, Blizzard and Ice Tomb against foes.

Discordant Surges are the plague-twisted elemental scouts sent to the Eastern Plaguelands. Neptulon’s Aspect can fight the poison within them, but the cure leaves them in a conflict that drives them into surging madness. Their Discordant Bracers are sought as part of the effort to bind this affliction.
Furis is a demon.
A Frostwolf Shaman, this caster prepares with Lightning Shield before combat, pairing a defensive ward with the shaman's spellcasting role.
Largent is a lieutenant.
Lieutenant Stouthandle is a named battlefield lieutenant who can yield a Dwarf Spine, sought in Alterac Valley’s campaign against opposing dwarves. The task is directed to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl.

Lieutenant Greywand is a named lieutenant whose loot includes a Frostwolf Lieutenant’s Medal and a Human Bone Chip. The chip is required for “The Human Condition,” an Alterac Valley task to kill human players and collect bone chips; the medal is required by a separate quest.

Lieutenant Lonadin is a named military figure in the Alterac Valley conflict. His loot includes a Dwarf Spine required for Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl’s “Wanted: DWARVES!” task, which directs Frostwolf fighters to take dwarf spines to Frostwolf Keep.
Mancuso is a lieutenant.

Hive'Ashi Ambushers are silithid threats associated with the hive activity investigated at Southwind Village. Layo Starstrike describes the hive as responsive to its surroundings and asks for unusual discoveries; the Encrusted Silithid Object is a quest item tied to this ambusher.
Coldmine Peon is a humanoid peon. It casts Sunder Armor while fighting.
Coldmine Miner is a humanoid miner. It casts Sunder Armor while fighting.
Commander Mortimer is a humanoid commander.

Commander Duffy is a humanoid commander who directs a search in Frostwolf territory for the missing Wing Commanders Slidore, Vipore, and Ichman, last reported near Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep.
Commander Karl Philips is a Stormpike commander. Louis Philips identifies Karl as his brother and describes him as the most dangerous of the four Stormpike commanders.
Seasoned Guardsman is a humanoid guardsman.
A Seasoned Mountaineer, identified by a mountaineer’s field role and seasoned rank.
A Seasoned Defender. In combat, it uses Revenge and Shield Block.
A Seasoned Sentinel, identified by its sentinel role and seasoned rank.
A Seasoned Guardian. It uses Revenge in combat.
A Seasoned Legionnaire, identified by its legionnaire role and seasoned rank.
A Seasoned Warrior, identified by its warrior role and seasoned rank.
A Veteran Defender. It uses Revenge in combat.
A Veteran Guardian. It uses Revenge in combat.
A veteran guardsman recorded as a humanoid combatant. Its native loot includes Darkspear Troll Mojo, a quest-required item.
A veteran legionnaire recorded as a humanoid combatant. Its native loot includes Darkspear Troll Mojo, a quest-required item.
A veteran mountaineer recorded as a humanoid combatant. Its native loot includes Armor Scraps, a quest-required item.
A Veteran Sentinel is a seasoned sentry, its title marking a distinct watch role among the battlefield combatants. Its loot includes Armor Scraps required by a quest.

A Veteran Warrior is identified as an experienced fighter, with the warrior title making its battlefield role clear. This entry is directly associated with Armor Scraps required by a quest, a concrete supply detail linked to its combat role.
A Core Rat is a small rat creature.
A warrior.
A Stormpike mine layer is a battlefield specialist whose role is identified by mine laying and association with the Stormpike force, rather than by a personal name.
A Frostwolf mine layer is a battlefield specialist whose role is identified by mine laying and association with the Frostwolf force, rather than by a personal name.
A Stormpike bowman is an archer of the Stormpike force, serving its ranged-combat role.
A Frostwolf bowman is an archer of the Frostwolf force, serving its ranged-combat role.
A Frostwolf Shredder Unit is a mechanical combat unit associated with the Frostwolf force, identified as a war machine rather than a named individual.
An Irondeep miner is a worker associated with Irondeep, defined by mining work rather than a separate personal identity.
An Irondeep peon, a humanoid who uses Sunder Armor in combat.
A mechanical combatant identified as a Stormpike Shredder Unit.
Ivus the Forest Lord is a named figure whose title associates him with the forest.
A humanoid champion guardian, identified by a title of protection.
A humanoid champion defender, identified by a title of defense.
A humanoid champion guardsman, identified by a title of watch and protection.

A Champion Legionnaire is presented as a distinguished legionnaire in a combat role. This entry is directly associated with Darkspear Troll Mojo required by a quest, a specific battlefield item connected to this combatant.
A mountaineer bearing the champion designation.
A sentinel bearing the champion designation.
A warrior bearing the champion designation.
Seersa Copperpinch represents Smokywood Pastures and offers goods for browsing.
A Frostwolf Wolf Rider recorded in Alterac Valley. Its native loot record links it directly to Darkspear Troll Mojo required by a quest, placing it in the battlefield’s combat context.
Sent from Darnassus to aid the Stormpike, this druid believes Ivus the Forest Lord will come when he learns of the valley's destruction. The druids leave judgement of those atrocities to Ivus.

Corporal Noreg Stormpike reports that supplies are too low for large ground assaults and directs veterans to the quartermaster for supply missions. He also issues Stormpike orders concerning the campaign against the opposing orcs.
Noxxion's Spawn is a creature.
A Risen Ancient.
A Frostwolf Outrunner.
A seasoned outrunner, this humanoid combatant is level 59. Its title marks it as seasoned among the outrunner ranks.
A veteran outrunner, this humanoid combatant is level 60. Its title marks it as veteran among the outrunner ranks.
A champion outrunner, this humanoid combatant is level 61. Its title marks it as a champion among the outrunner ranks.
A Stormpike ranger, this humanoid combatant is level 56. The name identifies its ranger role with the Stormpike.
A seasoned ranger, this humanoid combatant is level 59. Its title marks it as seasoned among the ranger ranks.
A veteran ranger, this humanoid combatant is level 60. Its title marks it as veteran among the ranger ranks.
A champion ranger, this humanoid combatant is level 56. Its title marks it as a champion among the ranger ranks.
A Stormpike commando, this humanoid combatant is level 56. The name identifies its commando role with the Stormpike.
A seasoned commando, this humanoid combatant is level 59. Its title marks it as seasoned among the commando ranks.
A veteran commando, this humanoid combatant is level 60. Its title marks it as veteran among the commando ranks.
A champion commando, this humanoid combatant is level 61. Its title marks it as a champion among the commando ranks.
A Frostwolf reaver, this humanoid combatant is level 56. The name identifies its reaver role with the Frostwolf.
A Seasoned Reaver recorded in Alterac Valley. Its native loot record links it directly to quest-required Armor Scraps, placing it in the battlefield’s combat context.
A Veteran Reaver that can yield Darkspear Troll Mojo needed for a quest.
A reaver bearing the champion designation.
A seasoned Coldmine guard who meets attackers with Strike and Backhand, this fighter has a clear close-combat role.
A veteran Coldmine guard who meets attackers with Strike, this fighter has a clear close-combat role.
A champion Coldmine guard who meets attackers with Strike, this fighter has a clear close-combat role.
A seasoned Coldmine surveyor who can answer attackers with Holy Smite, this unit has a combat role alongside its surveying identity.
A veteran Coldmine surveyor who can answer attackers with Holy Smite, this unit has a combat role alongside its surveying identity.
A champion surveyor associated with Coldmine, encountered in dungeon combat. This one uses holy and shadow spells and can heal itself when badly hurt.
A seasoned explorer of Irondeep, represented in dungeon encounters. Its behavior includes holding its ground while out of combat.
A veteran explorer of Irondeep, represented in dungeon encounters. It holds its ground while out of combat.
A champion explorer of Irondeep, represented in dungeon encounters. It holds its ground while out of combat.
A seasoned Irondeep raider encountered in dungeon combat, where it uses a strike against its opponent.
A veteran Irondeep raider encountered in dungeon combat, where it uses a strike against its opponent.
A champion Irondeep raider that uses a strike against its opponent in combat.

A Seasoned Coldmine Explorer, this spell-using combatant brings Frost Armor, Fireball, Fire Blast and Cone of Cold into its encounter. The record gives it no further personal history or purpose for exploring.
A Veteran Coldmine Explorer, this humanoid is represented in the dungeon encounter as a combatant. The supplied record gives no further personal history or reason for its exploration.
A Champion Coldmine Explorer, this humanoid is a combatant.
A Seasoned Coldmine Invader: its name identifies it as an invader, and the native record represents it as a combatant. No further personal motive or history is established.
A Veteran Coldmine Invader: its name identifies it as an invader, and the native record represents it as a combatant. No further personal motive or history is established.
A Champion Coldmine Invader: its name identifies it as an invader, and the native record represents it as a combatant. No further personal motive or history is established.
A Seasoned Irondeep Guard: its name identifies a guard role, and the native record represents it as a combatant. No further personal history or specific duty is established.
A Veteran Irondeep Guard, this fighter represents the guard contingent. Its combat behavior includes Mortal Strike.
A Champion Irondeep Guard, this fighter represents the guard contingent at champion rank. Its combat behavior includes Mortal Strike.
A Seasoned Irondeep Surveyor, this combatant has a surveyor's designation and uses Holy Smite in combat.
A Veteran Irondeep Surveyor, this combatant has a surveyor's designation and uses Holy Smite in combat.
A Champion Irondeep Surveyor, this combatant has a surveyor's designation and uses Holy Smite in combat.
A Stormpike Ram Rider, this rider is a combatant.
The Stabled Frostwolf is a beast.
Gizlock is a humanoid known by that name.
The Stabled Alterac Ram is a beast.
A corrupted Noxxious Scion emerges from a Vylestem vine in Maraudon after a vial is used on it. The quests direct adventurers to kill these scions as part of healing the plants.
Noxxious Essence is an elemental.
Veng is the Fifth Kahn, a demon.
Maraudos is the Fourth Kahn, a demon.
Magra is the Third Kahn. A Theradric Crystal Carving requested in Willow's Maraudon-related quest can be obtained from him.
Gelk is the Second Kahn. A Theradric Crystal Carving requested in Willow's Maraudon-related quest can be obtained from him.
Kolk is the First Kahn. A Theradric Crystal Carving requested in Willow's Maraudon-related quest can be obtained from him.

Alterac Yeti is a beast whose combat techniques include Frost Breath and War Stomp.
Tortured Drake is a drake. Its name describes it as tortured.
Gash'nak the Cannibal is a humanoid, identified by a personal name and a stark epithet.
Ushalac the Gloomdweller is a humanoid, identified by a personal name and an evocative epithet.
Withered Troll is a humanoid troll, named for its withered condition.
Rezrelek is a humanoid identified by the title Winterax Hero, which associates him with the Winterax.
Tatterhide is a humanoid.
A Winterax sentry, identified as a sentry of the Winterax.
Rytama bears the title Binder of the Moro'gai.
Phase Lasher (Fire) is the fire-aspected form of a Phase Lasher, identified by its elemental name.
Phase Lasher (Nature) is the nature-aspected form of a Phase Lasher, identified by its elemental name.
Phase Lasher (Arcane) is the arcane-aspected form of a Phase Lasher, identified by its elemental name.
An enraged felguard that fights with Thunderclap and goes into a frenzy when badly hurt.
A Stormpike Reclaimer.
A Frostwolf Reclaimer.
Ar'lia, titled The Moro'gai, is a non-combat pet.
Taroen is a humanoid bearing the designation The Moro'gai.
Ja'ker is a humanoid bearing the designation The Moro'gai.
Urrul is a humanoid bearing the designation The Moro'gai.
Lorael is a humanoid bearing the designation The Moro'gai.
Fre'an is a humanoid bearing the designation The Moro'gai.
Karana, called The Moro'gai, is a humanoid.
RaidMage is an arcane mage.
A frost Phase Lasher, an elemental.
Athramanis is a bounty hunter who offers quests.
Sulhasa is a wind rider master.
An elite blue drakonid that casts Brood Power: Blue in combat.
An elite green drakonid that casts Brood Power: Green in combat.
An elite bronze drakonid that casts Brood Power: Bronze in combat.
An elite red drakonid that casts Brood Power: Red in combat.
An elite black drakonid that casts Brood Power: Black in combat.
A beast known as a Winterax Tracker.
Chromatic Drakonid is a dragonkin.

The Human Orphan is a young Alliance admirer of Jaina Proudmoore who hopes to become an Alliance hero. The orphan asks an adventurer to seek Jaina’s autograph and dreams of thanking her in person someday. Their interests also include becoming king of Stormwind, visiting Ironforge, and curious questions about the world.
Eskhandar is a named beast that fights with Shred and Exploit Weakness.
A black war wolf.
A black war raptor.
A red skeletal warhorse.
A black war steed.
A black war kodo.
A black mechanical battlestrider.
A black war ram.
A black war tiger.
Felendor the Accuser is a humanoid.
Captain Greshkil is a captain.
Hydroling is an elemental creature that initiates attacks.
The Gordok Bushwacker is occupied with putting tannin in a basket and threatens to use the mallet again if the task is not done. It repeats the line while moving.
Duke Landressar bears the title Agent of Therazane.

Mizzle the Crafty presents himself as the former king's assistant. After announcing the king's death, he hails his listeners as Gordok's new rulers, explains that surviving henchmen owe tribute, and offers to teach them the king's role. His quick pivot and emphasis on his usefulness give his loyalty a calculating edge.
Thornling calls out as it begins to grow, continues growing, and reaches full size.
A spirit associated with the House of Shen'dralar, it offers a quest interaction and acknowledges a selected target with a bow, applause, cheer, or salute.
A cadaverous worm, identified by its worm designation.
A Winterfall ambusher, identified as a humanoid.
A Doomguard Minion is a demon.
A Netherwalker demon that starts attacking when combat begins and casts Shadow Bolt Volley.
Dire Maul Reaver Post.
The Eye of Immol'thar begins attacking out of combat and uses a spell named after itself during combat.
Mana Burst casts Arcane Explosion when a target enters its 0–9-yard range.
Seeker Cromwell is a questgiver who casts Hooked Net in combat.
Seeker Nahr is a questgiver who casts Hooked Net in combat.
Seeker Thompson is a questgiver who casts Hooked Net in combat.
A roving kodo, identified as a beast.
A brown prairie dog, identified as a non-combat pet.
An alarm bot associated with alerting.
Prince Thunderaan, the Wind Seeker, is an elemental prince.

Grunth is an orcish orphan whose parents died honorably in battle, according to his matron. He looks to the Horde’s heroes and dreams of becoming one himself: he wants to sail as a Horde sailor, see the frontier in Ashenvale, and visit the throne room where Arthas betrayed his father. He admires Cairne Bloodhoof and is thrilled when Cairne sends him a personal message. During Children’s Week he welcomes the adventurer looking after him as a big brother and hopes they will share adventures.
An enslaved Doomguard Commander speaks of a future sacrifice if a mortal calls upon him.
The Alliance Battle Standard, identified by its Alliance designation.
The Horde Battle Standard, identified by its Horde designation.
A Xorothian imp, a demon.
A demonic Dread Guard that fights with cleaving attacks.
An injured peasant terrified of the approaching Scourge, pleading for help and urging others to seek sanctuary in Hearthglen. The peasant warns that the Prince has gone mad.
A plagued peasant whose warnings urge people to flee the Scourge and seek sanctuary in Hearthglen.
An undead Scourge footsoldier serving Kel’Thuzad.
An undead archer of the Scourge.

J'eevee is a clever imp who infuses Mor'zul's parchment with Xorothian stardust in Scholomance. His work sequence has him begin the process, announce its final step and completion, then tell the player to return the jar to Gorzeeki with the parchment.
The Cleaner is a demon.

In the Dreadsteed of Xoroth ritual, this defeated steed's spirit is bound to the summoner. Though rage still pulses through its ghostly flanks, it whispers dark magic that teaches the summoner to call a dreadsteed.
A demon known as Dreadsteed.
Banehollow says Lord Hel'nurath is plotting with his servant Ulathek and plans to usurp his power on Xoroth, making Hel'nurath a rival in Banehollow's eyes.
A shadowed spirit that attacks with Shadow Bolt and recoils as the Judgement of Light washes over it.
A corrupted spirit that attacks with Corruption and recoils as the Judgement of Righteousness washes over it.
A hostile spirit that fights with Rend. When struck by the Judgement of Justice, it recoils in pain.
A hostile spirit that fights with Befuddlement. When struck by the Judgement of Wisdom, it recoils in pain.
High Priestess Arlokk calls on Bethekk for strength and urges her panthers to feast on her foe. As she dies, she declares herself free of the Soulflayer.

Death Knight Darkreaver is tied to the Great Ossuary and threatens to twist the spirit realm to his own ends. In combat, he warns that his foes will join his bone collection and attacks with Blood Leech and Cleave.
Aspect of Banality emerges from darkness when drawn out by the divination scryer. It recoils under Judgement of Wisdom and fights with Befuddlement and Demoralize.
Aspect of Corruption emerges from darkness when drawn out by the divination scryer. It recoils under Judgement of Righteousness and attacks with Shadow Word: Pain.
Aspect of Malice emerges from darkness when drawn out by the divination scryer. It recoils under Judgement of Justice and attacks with Rend.
Aspect of Shadow emerges from darkness when drawn out by the divination scryer. It recoils under Judgement of Light and attacks with Shadow Bolt and Shadow Shock.

Solenor the Slayer is named by Vartrus the Ancient as one of four demonic corrupters targeted in a hunt for Burning Legion agents. Vartrus warns that these agents flee if attacked in a group; the task calls for a solo hunt and lists Solenor's head among the required items.

Simone the Seductress is named by Vartrus the Ancient as one of four demonic corrupters targeted in a hunt for Burning Legion agents. Vartrus warns that these agents flee if attacked in a group; the task calls for a solo hunt and lists Simone's head among the required items.

Klinfran the Crazed is named by Vartrus the Ancient as one of four demonic corrupters targeted in a hunt for Burning Legion agents. Vartrus warns that these agents flee if attacked in a group; the task calls for a solo hunt and lists Klinfran's head among the required items.

Artorius the Doombringer is named among four demonic corrupters described as active agents of the Burning Legion, corrupting everything they touch. He is a target to track down and destroy alone; the instructions demand his head alongside those of the other three corrupters.
Precious the Devourer is identified as Simone's pet.
A mechanical Swift Stripped Mechanostrider.
A Swift Dawnsaber is a beast.
A mechanical Swift Blue Mechanostrider.
A mechanical Swift Red Mechanostrider.
A spirit haunting Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands. Lord Grayson's censer is used to drive out the spirits tormenting the area, and these spirits attack with Wailing Dead.
A beast known as Charger.

A fallen charger whose lost soul is reclaimed after Death Knight Darkreaver is defeated. Returning its judged soul and fitting blessed enchanted barding redeems the beast; it nuzzles the person who restores it and can then be called as a steed.
Sergeant Thunderhorn is the weapons quartermaster, offering weapons for sale and serving as a quest contact.

A zapped Shore Strider is a giant reduced by Zorbin Fandazzle's Ultra-Shrinker to a more manageable form. The altered creature yields Miniaturization Residue, gathered from zapped giants for Zorbin's work. Its name distinguishes this shore-striding form from other giant kinds.

A zapped Land Walker is a giant reduced by Zorbin Fandazzle's Ultra-Shrinker to a more manageable form. The altered creature yields Miniaturization Residue, gathered from zapped giants for Zorbin's work. Its name distinguishes this land-walking form from other giant kinds.
A bone construct that can exploit an enemy's weakness when it gets behind them.
The Warsong Gulch Battlemaster is a humanoid.
A non-combat pet named Loggerhead Snapjaw.
A non-combat pet named Leatherback Snapjaw.
A non-combat pet named Olive Snapjaw.
A non-combat pet named Hawksbill Snapjaw.
A non-combat pet named Albino Snapjaw.
A sleepy Dark Iron worker who cries that “our pillas” have been stolen and warns that the act will not go unpunished.

Chambermaid Pillaclencher is a summoned encounter opponent who greets the player with an indignant cry of “Thieves! Scallywags! Rapscallions!” and challenges them to face her gigantic pillows. Her death triggers the pillow’s drop, tying the confrontation to the odd pillow theft.
A wave strider in a zapped state.
A deep strider in a zapped state.
A cliff giant in a zapped state.
A humanoid Alliance herald.
A humanoid Horde herald.
A herald of Warsong Gulch.
A corrupted infernal that casts Immolation in combat.
A critter known as Transporter Malfunction.
Baron Titus Rivendare is an undead figure.
Morbus is an undead.
Soulless is an undead creature.

Prince Sandoval is a blood prince whose arrival at Valhalas follows the outsider’s success there. He addresses the Spear-Wife before confronting the outsider, condemns the outsider’s trespasses and defilement of the battle site, and invokes the Lich King as he attacks.
A mana elemental.
Basalt is an undead.
Wollstonecraft is an undead.
Scorn is an undead combatant summoned to patrol. In battle, Scorn uses Frost Nova, Mind Flay, Lich Slap, and Frostbolt Volley.
Necrosis is an undead.
A Stitched Behemoth is an undead creature.
A lumbering undead combatant that knocks opponents down during a fight.
Silent Stalker is a creature known by a name that suggests quiet pursuit.
Spectral Soldier is a spectral soldier.
Unclean Spirit is a spirit.
Doom Wraith is a wraith.
Wailing Widow has a title-like name.
Death Siren has a name evoking a siren.
A skittering dread, an undead creature.
A Nerubian Webspinner, an undead creature.

A decaying undead warrior.
A Blighted Dead, an undead creature.
Dread Sorcerer is an undead sorcerer.
An undead ghoul identified as a Midden Ghoul.
An undead creature identified as a Putrid Flyer.
An undead creature identified as a Winged Horror.
Saurfang bears the title of High Overlord.
Frostwolf Howler is a wolf creature.
A Stormpike Battle Charger is a beast.
A Horde tower lieutenant.

A Vilebranch kidnapper taunts victims caught in its trap, calling them dinner and threatening that the High Priestess will feast on their bones. It attacks weakened targets and may flee for help when badly hurt.
The Frostwolf Battle Standard.
The Stormpike Battle Standard.
A tiny red dragon.
A creature named Creeping Doom.

A marshal assigned to the south of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley.
An Icewing marshal assigned to the Alterac Valley battlefield.
A Stonehearth marshal assigned to the Alterac Valley battlefield.
An Iceblood marshal.

A West Frostwolf marshal in Alterac Valley.

A Dun Baldar South warmaster.

A humanoid warmaster known as the Iceblood Warmaster.

The Icewing Warmaster is a named Alterac Valley battlefield combatant, identified with the Icewing position. Its records connect it to the Call of Air effort through Vipore’s fleet, while establishing no dialogue or service duties.

The Stonehearth Warmaster is a named Alterac Valley battlefield combatant, identified with the Stonehearth position. Its direct quest-required loot includes Darkspear Troll Mojo, tying this warmaster to the battlefield’s combat without establishing dialogue or service duties.
A humanoid warmaster known as the Tower Point Warmaster.

The West Frostwolf Warmaster is a named Alterac Valley battlefield combatant, identified with the West Frostwolf position. Its marshal/warmaster script binding places it in the battleground’s warmaster role; its direct quest-required loot also includes Armor Scraps.
A wild polymorph target, a critter.

Captain Skarloc is a commander pursuing Thrall on Blackmoore’s behalf. He intends to return Thrall to Blackmoore, insults him as an “ignorant savage,” and insists that Thrall will never be free or anything but a slave.
This demon enters combat when summoned, casts Cripple while fighting, and answers nearby hostiles with War Stomp.
Matis bears the title Herald of Sironas. Vindicator Kuros calls him Matis the Cruel and seeks his capture, accusing him of being a killer; Kuros wants him returned to the Triumvirate.
The Angered Nether-wraith fights with Arcane Bolt and Shadow Blast, adjusting its movement as opponents draw nearer or move away and as its mana shifts.
Murkblood Foreman is a Murkblood whose name identifies an overseeing role.
Murkblood Henchman is identified as Murkblood Foreman's Flunky, a Murkblood. The title places this henchman in a subordinate role to the foreman.
An image of Velen.

The Hunter of the Hand leads a hunt for Matis, a blood elf the speaker says must be brought to justice, and rallies the group with a promised week’s vacation aboard the Exodar for whoever finds him first. He answers to a lord, calls the Hand his brothers and sisters, and urges them onward into Bloodmyst’s wilds.

Chrono Lord Deja serves the Infinite Dragonflight’s effort to stop the Magus from opening a portal, arguing that preventing it could save lives and erase the wars that follow. He calls the opposing effort a foolish quest, threatens those who persist, and orders the Keeper away; his confidence in time’s advantage persists even as he dies.

Temporus tries to dissuade intruders by calling their effort futile and warning that they can still leave alive. When they persist, he says they have been warned and insists the Keeper’s time has run out. His parting threats frame the encounter as a contest the intruders should have abandoned.

Aeonus speaks for a cause that seeks to shatter the “clockwork universe” and end enslavement to the hourglass, warning that those who refuse will fall victim to time’s passing. He calls the opposing Keeper a slave of the past and treats the encounter as an obstacle to his cause. A separate contract places an hourglass in his possession.
Kaz'rogal is an encounter foe who speaks with contempt and menace. He threatens those he marks, taunts the people he kills, and promises a painful death, giving him the voice of a cruel combatant.
An Infinite Chronomancer summoned as a Black Morass combatant, it fights with Arcane magic and speaks of the Last Guardian and refusing failure.

Windcaller Claw is one of four investigators sent by Ysiel to examine the steam pumps draining the marsh. The group split up and went ahead; Watcher Jhang asks others to discover what happened to them in the Slave Pens and Underbog.
A Crypt Fiend serving among Hyjal's ground forces, it belongs to the undead opposition faced there.
An undead skeleton invader.
A Skeleton Mage is an undead combatant.
A banshee in the Hyjal encounter.
A gargoyle in the Hyjal encounter.
A frost wyrm in the Hyjal encounter.
A giant infernal.
Gregor is a Justiciar of the Order of the Silver Hand. His challenge invokes the sanctity of Alonsus Chapel; he attacks and casts Holy Light.
Cathela the Seeker is identified with the Order of the Silver Hand. In her chapel encounter she attacks, using Holy Light and Crusader Strike.
An Order of the Silver Hand combatant, Nemas attacks challengers and casts Holy Light. He calls his opponent a blasphemer and warns them to prepare for their fate.
An Order of the Silver Hand combatant, Aelmar attacks challengers and casts Holy Light. He challenges a false paladin and threatens them with the wrath of the Light's true servants.
An Order of the Silver Hand combatant, Vicar Hieronymus attacks challengers and casts Holy Light. He condemns their actions as abominable and demands atonement for crimes against the Light.
A fel stalker in the Hyjal encounter.
The Time Keeper urges the fight onward, insisting on victory and telling others not to falter; it casts Sand Breath in combat.
An Ancient Wisp.

In his Dream communication with Remulos, Malfurion describes fighting beside Cenarius and fears the Nightmare is spreading beyond the Dream after Ysera’s brood falls victim to ancient whisperings. He urges preparation among the mortal races and worries that Illidan’s defeat by Arthas has shattered his mind and may test their bond. Being drawn back, he asks Remulos to send Tyrande his love and reassure her that he is safe and will return.
A hungry bog lord that inspects a mushroom tree with its nose, eats a piece, then uproots the rest and carries it away.
A Crypt Scarab.
A stormcrow in its stormcrow shape.
A Sunhawk agent in a captured transformation.
A manifestation associated with Ysiel.
A humanoid Lordaeron Veteran.
A Lordaeron fighter.
A red alpha riding wolf: a wolf identified by its red coloring and alpha designation.
A guardian water elemental, identified as an elemental associated with water.
A Horde healing ward, a ward associated with healing.
A spirit named Spirit of Victory.
A lich, an undead creature.
A doomguard lord, a demon.
An Umbrafen slavebinder threatens a druid who might escape, marking it as a captor and antagonist.
A humanoid named Rajah Kaz'sith.
A humanoid named Rajah Vethag.
A Bleeding Hollow archer with a ranged combat role.
A Bleeding Hollow darkcaster with a spellcasting combat role.
A Bleeding Hollow scryer.

An elite watchkeeper's subordinate, titled “Watchkeeper's Subordinate.”
A beast designated as a Shattered Hand warhound.
A mechanical fel reaver designated “Fel Reaver Netherstorm.”
A demon designated as a Netherstorm felguard.

Mannoroth’s dialogue expresses contempt for resistance: he expects an adversary to arrive with Hellscream, dismisses their effort as futile and claims that another’s blood and his opponent’s whole race belong to him. He taunts an opponent that they share the same darkness within. Accounts associate his blood with the Thunderlord clan’s transformation into fel orcs.

Grom Hellscream is Chieftain of the Warsong Clan. Addressing Thrall, he speaks of the blood haze lifting and the demon’s fire burning out in his veins, claiming to have freed himself. His eyes grow dim when the blood curse lifts.
A rabbit-type critter given the ominous name “The Evil Rabbit.”
A named humanoid known as Atsun of the Air.

Far'hir of the Flame is an elemental.
Watoosun of the Water is an elemental.
A system event handler associated by name with the Elemental Throne.
Doomfire.
The Epoch Hunter opposes Thrall's future and declares its intent to kill Thrall and his allies. Afterward, it taunts them with its intended outcomes: Thrall will remain enslaved and Taretha will die.
A Doomfire Spirit.
Overseer Tidewrath, a humanoid overseer.
An Expedition Scout.
An Outland Shivan demon.
A humanoid Spirit Healer (DND).
Ssslith is a humanoid.
A cannon test target designated to serve as a target during cannon testing.
An elekk assigned to ground taxi transport.
The Crone is a hostile encounter figure who greets attackers with theatrical menace, then answers her defeat with a plaintive complaint. Her taunts also boast of fixing a foe.
A Blood Knight initiate, a novice in the Blood Knight order.
An Infinite Slayer combatant that uses Mortal Strike in combat.
An Infinite Defiler combatant that casts Shadow Bolt in combat.
The Infinite Saboteur is a combatant.

Gurok is a foe whom Gordawg asks the player to destroy. The quest places him at Warmaul Hill among ogres who worship him and describes summoning him; in combat, he uses Earth Shock and Entangling Roots.
A Mo'arg Engineer form designated for Magnetic Mode.
An Expedition Preserver.
A bird spirit illusion.
A tamed sporebat.
Elekk, Mount (Elite) is identified as an elekk mount.
The Shadow of Aran is a powerful hostile humanoid that casts Pyroblast in combat.
Khoraazi is titled Chairman of the Consortium.
Kruugall is titled Shaman Trainer.
The Consortium Prospector has a role tied to prospecting for the Consortium.
Razorgill is a beast.
A humanoid named Cailan.
Gankly Rottenfist ambushes Kristen, takes her bundle of skins, and demands a reward from Harold in exchange.
Priest Kath'mar provides a service and asks those who need further help to summon him again.

Highlord Kruul is a Burning Crusade invader who threatens Azeroth and searches for the Aspect Shards, convinced their power will let his side overcome the world. He taunts mortals as prey, rages when the Shards elude him, and dismisses a place as unworthy when he leaves.
A wyvern associated with riding in the Nagrand PvP event.
An ebon gryphon.
A Swift Red Wind Rider is a red riding beast.
Netherwhelp is a noncombat pet.
An Ethereal Wraith is an elemental creature.
A Boulderfist Saboteur is identified by its Boulderfist affiliation and sabotage role, marking it as an operative in that group.
A Kil'sorrow Invader is a humanoid identified by its Kil'sorrow affiliation and invading role.
Brokentoe is a named clefthoof challenger in the Ring of Blood, known for charging and hoof stomps. Its arena role is coordinated through Gurgthock.
A Murkblood Twin is an arena combatant who boasts of the Blue brothers' dominance and fights with Sinister Strike and Eviscerate.
Rokdar the Sundered Lord is identified as a giant from Blade's Edge and a formidable Ring of Blood challenger. He boasts in blunt terms and calls out after using Knock Away.

Presented as the next Ring of Blood match and rumored to be a void lord, Skra'gath draws challengers closer with a void-themed taunt. As attacks land, he announces absorbing holy, fire, nature, frost, and shadow energy.
The Warmaul Champion threatens to tear the challenger apart. His behavior includes charging, Mortal Strike, and Sundering Cleave.
A sporebat.
A Swift Blue Gryphon.
Cyclone bears the designation “The Crone.”
Peep, an Outland phoenix.
An Arcane Fiend uses Arcane Explosion in combat and casts Counterspell on a target.
An Ethereal Apprentice is a combatant that casts Fireball in combat.
Nazan is Vazruden's mount.

Vazruden is a creature.

An undead Stolen Soul summoned by Exarch Maladaar to attack a chosen target.

Prospector Balmoral is an Explorers' League prospector camped southwest of Veil Shalas, near the edge of the Bone Wastes. Travelers seeking information about the arakkoa settlement are directed to consult him before acting there.
Lookout Nodak is a scout stationed southwest of Veil Shalas, near the edge of the Bone Wastes. Travelers investigating the arakkoa settlement are directed to consult him before taking action there.
Veil Shalas Ward is a primal magical defense protecting the arakkoa settlement. Scouts are sent to approach it while assessing the town's defenses.
A Shalassi sentry assigned to watch duty.
A beast known as Old Crappy McWeaksauce.
The Avatar of the Martyred is summoned into combat.
A warding totem guarding the approach to Veil Shalas. Kokorek describes the totems as defenses whose wards his talisman can unravel.
Deirom is a prisoner held by Luanga in Veil Shalas. Lady Dena Kennedy's mission warns that the arakkoa may move or kill him if they discover their defenses have been breached.
Dugar is an orc prisoner held by the arakkoa in Veil Shalas. Rokag asks rescuers to find him and deal with his captor, fearing the arakkoa may move or kill him.
An unliving soldier who guards with Protection Aura and uses Shield Bash in combat.
An unliving sorcerer that casts a random spell during combat in the normal dungeon setting.
An unliving cleric who cries, “Light will save purge us all!” when aggroed. The line gives this undead combatant a fervent appeal to the Light amid its hostile encounter.
An unliving stalker that phases in when summoned, joining the hostile encounter.
A phantasmal possessor that phases in when summoned and casts Possess in combat.
K'ode.
Ve'ru.

Luanga is an arakkoa captor at Veil Shalas, targeted in the missions to rescue Deirom or Dugar. When attacked, he vows to keep Skywing cursed, suggesting a determined personal stake in their conflict; he also uses Chain Lightning in combat.
A demonic soldier called a Soldier of Hate.
Nethrandamus Taxi is a dragon associated with transport.

Veraku leads the nether drakes at the Celestial Ridge. The blue flight seeks to displace him through a dominance challenge: the Challenge of the Blue Flight provokes him, and he attacks when summoned.
Ashes of Al'ar.
A wild elekk serving as a Murkblood mount.
A Tuurem ambusher.
An Aldor mason.

A Durnholde mage in Blackmoore’s service, this soldier follows orders and threatens challengers in his commander’s name. His idle remark that Blackmoore has been acting strangely suggests unease about his leader, though he gives no further explanation.

Perry Gatner tells others he has just flown in from Ironforge and asks them to go easy because it is his first time. His banter ranges from a hostile reputation and a murloc at his window to leftovers and Greater Boots of Laughter.

Lord Marshal Raynor rallies marshals and heroes of Azeroth to stand against the demonic threat. He demands courage and persistence, and urges the kingdoms to set aside old feuds so they can face the darkness together. His speeches embrace defenders across faction lines; when his force leaves to seek aid, he promises that the others will not fight alone.
A Stormwind marshal who serves as a close-combat fighter, answering threats with forceful strikes.
A Felguard Lieutenant, a powerful demonic fighter whose combat routine includes Skull Crack.
A Goblin Steam Tonk, a mechanical construct identified with goblin engineering.
A Gnomish Steam Tonk, a mechanical construct identified with gnomish engineering.

Image of Erozion is a magical presence charged with manipulating time around Thrall’s death. He can turn time back to before Thrall dies, but says this power is limited; he has reset the flow of time once more and warns that failure to prevent Thrall’s death would mean all is lost.
Angersmith Okkos is a humanoid bearing the Angersmith designation.
A fallen Stormwind infantry soldier, this humanoid represents one of the kingdom’s dead foot troops.
A skeleton bearing the Bleeding Hollow name, this undead creature connects its remains with that clan.
A ravager described as tamed, this creature belongs to a domesticated animal role rather than a named individual identity.
An undead skeleton identified as an orc, this creature is presented as a generic kind rather than an individual.
A Bleeding Hollow soul, an undead creature.
A Dreghood warrior fleeing after the taskmaster’s death, urging the others to run. The warrior calls this their chance to escape and repeats the warning to flee.
A Darkened Spirit that cries, “What... What have I become?” Its words suggest alarm at its changed state. It attacks with Consuming Shadows and vanishes shortly after death.
A dragonhawk used as a mount.

A Horde flying-mount vendor and horse-riding trainer.

Ekkorash the Inquisitor leads the demons at Arklon Ruins and holds Archmage Vargoth’s staff. Drawn from hiding, Ekkorash angrily complains about being summoned only for the elf’s return, then dismisses the unexpected visitor as someone who will not detain them long.
Master Handler Sylvester is a humanoid bearing the title Master Handler.
A mechanical guardpost called Altar of Shattra Scryer Guardpost.
The Ember of Al’ar begins passive, becomes aggressive, enters combat with its zone, and casts Ember Blast when it dies.
A mechanical goblin zeppelin.
A humanoid worker identified with the Sunfury.

Warchief Thrall longs to meet the Greatmother after knowing his parents’ lives on Draenor only through Orgrim’s stories. He remembers Orgrim as his greatest teacher and dearest friend. Thrall honors Grom as the hero who freed the orcs from the demon blood curse, saying he was beside him when he struck down Mannoroth. He wants Garrosh to see what his father sacrificed, so none can doubt Hellscream’s resolve.
Void Storm.
A humanoid Nethergarde Advisor, identified by that role designation.
